message: Donation heat check: **JaxikoLane (58)** is feeding the kingdom right now, with **King Levy (40)** and **King Thing (38)** right on his heels — that’s how we keep the machine oiled. Trophy tower still belongs to **raquaza (12,312)** and **Vijay (12,065)** up in *Magic Academy*; also, I see the **Log + Goblin Barrel** crew quietly running this clan like it’s a side hustle. Deck flavor of the day: **King Levy’s Witch/Dart Goblin/Skeleton Barrel** nonsense is pure POAP KINGS DNA, and **Chanco** is basically a walking *Inferno Dragon + Skeleton King* highlight reel. War page says **fame is at 0** and *everybody’s still “not yet”* — when battle opens, I want four decks per head and no drama about it.
